description: Feature contract v1 for the 5m-flip-prediction inverse-filter model. Freezes the 100-feature set as currently consumed by model_2026.txt. Snap call order matches the v3 collector (studies/1m_delayed_checkpoint_context/collector.py). Any change to names, definitions, null policy, default values, or call ordering requires a new contract version (v2).

snap_call_order_anchors.signal_time_check_confirmation: Read inside collector._check_confirmation(rec) which is called from collector._on_1m when bar+1 close fires. At this point: (1) atr_14.update_raw has run for bar+1, (2) regime_1m.update has run for bar+1 (regime is now sticky with the flip direction since bar+1 didn't reverse it), (3) _update_5m has run for bar+1 (5m may have updated if bar+1 minute_of_hour % 5 == 4), (4) _update_active_trades_on_1m has NOT yet run for bar+1. All sma20/sma50/ema indicators include bar+1 in their state.
snap_call_order_anchors.signal_time_root_features: Same call point as signal_time_check_confirmation. The root features dict is built by collector._snap_root_features(...) which is invoked from inside _check_confirmation BEFORE the trade is appended to _active_trades.
snap_call_order_anchors.decision_time_snap_checkpoint: Read inside collector._snap_checkpoint(ts_data, T, current_ts) called from collector._emit_30s_bar at NT processing time ts_init=signal_time+1s (the 1s bar with ts_event=signal_time). By this point bar+1's _on_1m has already run (1m bar's ts_init=signal_time, 1s bar's ts_init=signal_time+1s). Regime states reflect bar+1's update. Critical: this snap may fail to fire if there is no 1s bar at ts_event=signal_time (data gap), in which case checkpoint fields stay at default.
snap_call_order_anchors.static_per_event: Set once when the trade is registered and never updated. Examples: signal_direction, decision_checkpoint_s.

decision_time_definitions.signal_time: ts_event of bar+1 + 60_000_000_000 ns (bar+1 close timestamp)

features.name: decision_checkpoint_s
features.definition: T_d in seconds (always 0 for current production)
features.notes: Always 0 in current model; reserved for future delayed entries

features.name: atr_14
features.definition: AverageTrueRange(period=14) value at signal_time, AFTER atr_14.update_raw(bar+1.h, bar+1.l, bar+1.c). This is NT's built-in indicator (Wilder smoothed). Same as atr_at_signal at signal_time.
features.notes: Wilder smoothed ATR has FP accumulation drift over time

features.name: atr_at_signal
features.definition: Same as atr_14 — duplicate column maintained for legacy reasons.

features.name: flip_range_atr
features.definition: (flip_bar.h - flip_bar.l) / atr_14

features.name: flip_body_atr
features.definition: abs(flip_bar.c - flip_bar.o) / atr_14

features.name: flip_body_pct
features.definition: body / range, 0 if range==0

features.name: flip_close_location
features.definition: (c-l)/(h-l), 0.5 if range==0

features.name: flip_upper_wick_pct
features.definition: (h - max(o,c)) / range, 0 if range==0

features.name: flip_lower_wick_pct
features.definition: (min(o,c) - l) / range, 0 if range==0

features.name: flip_volume
features.definition: Total volume of flip bar

features.name: flip_vol_vs_20avg
features.definition: flip_bar.v / mean of last 20 1m bar volumes (excluding flip bar). Set in collector via _vol_vs_Navg(.., 20, 0).

features.name: flip_close_vs_prior_close_atr
features.definition: (flip_bar.c - prior_bar.c) * direction / atr_14. Multiplied by signal_direction.

features.name: flip_high_vs_prior_high_atr
features.definition: (flip_bar.h - prior_bar.h) * direction / atr_14

features.name: flip_low_vs_prior_low_atr
features.definition: (flip_bar.l - prior_bar.l) * direction / atr_14

features.name: flip_bar_bullish_volume_pct
features.definition: Sum of up-candle 1s bar volumes inside the 1m / (up + down volumes). Computed during _on_1s as current_1m_up_vol / (up_vol + down_vol). Default 0.5.

features.name: flip_bar_vol_rank_20
features.definition: Rank of flip_bar.v among last 20 1m bar volumes (0=lowest, 1=highest). Computed via _vol_rank_N.

features.name: bar1_range_atr
features.definition: (bar1.h - bar1.l) / atr_14

features.name: bar1_body_atr
features.definition: abs(bar1.c - bar1.o) / atr_14

features.name: bar1_body_pct
features.definition: bar1 body/range

features.name: bar1_close_location
features.definition: (bar1.c - bar1.l) / bar1.range

features.name: bar1_upper_wick_pct
features.definition: bar1 upper wick fraction of range

features.name: bar1_lower_wick_pct
features.definition: bar1 lower wick fraction of range

features.name: bar1_volume
features.definition: bar1 total volume

features.name: bar1_vol_vs_flip_vol
features.definition: bar1.v / flip.v, 1.0 if flip.v == 0

features.name: bar1_vol_rank_20
features.definition: bar1 volume rank vs prior 20 1m bars

features.name: bar1_hh_amount_atr
features.definition: long: (bar1.h - flip.h)/atr; short: (flip.l - bar1.l)/atr

features.name: bar1_close_vs_flip_close_atr
features.definition: (bar1.c - flip.c) * direction / atr_14

features.name: bar1_close_above_flip_close
features.definition: 1 if (bar1.c - flip.c) * direction > 0 else 0

features.name: bar1_close_above_50pct_range
features.definition: Long: 1 if bar1_close_loc > 0.5; Short: 1 if loc < 0.5

features.name: bar1_bullish_volume_pct
features.definition: bar1 up_vol / (up_vol + down_vol). Default 0.5.

features.name: two_bar_range_atr
features.definition: (max(flip.h, bar1.h) - min(flip.l, bar1.l)) / atr_14

features.name: two_bar_body_atr
features.definition: (bar1.c - flip.o) * direction / atr_14

features.name: two_bar_close_vs_open_pct
features.definition: (bar1.c - flip.o) / flip.o (relative pct move)

features.name: two_bar_volume_total
features.definition: flip.v + bar1.v

features.name: two_bar_vol_vs_40avg
features.definition: (flip.v + bar1.v) / mean of last 40 1m bar volumes

features.name: flip_low_to_bar1_high_atr
features.definition: (max(flip.h, bar1.h) - min(flip.l, bar1.l)) / atr_14 (intentionally same as two_bar_range_atr — legacy)
features.notes: Identical to two_bar_range_atr by collector code

features.name: prior_regime_duration_bars
features.definition: Number of 1m bars the prior regime was active before this flip (from collector flip_pending state)

features.name: consecutive_trend_bars_pre_flip
features.definition: Consecutive same-direction close-to-close moves in the 5 1m bars prior to flip. Computed in _snap_root_features.

features.name: pre_flip_3bar_body_direction
features.definition: Sign of cumulative body of 3 bars before flip (+1, 0, -1)

features.name: pre_flip_3bar_range_atr
features.definition: Sum of last 3 pre-flip 1m bar ranges / atr_14

features.name: pre_flip_5bar_range_atr
features.definition: Sum of last 5 pre-flip 1m bar ranges / atr_14

features.name: pre_flip_volume_trend
features.definition: Slope-like measure: (last_3_avg_vol - prior_3_avg_vol) / prior_3_avg_vol over pre-flip bars

features.name: regime_flips_last_30min
features.definition: Count of regime flips in the 30 1m bars prior to signal_time (collector counts flip_history within window)

features.name: regime_flips_last_60min
features.definition: Count of regime flips in the 60 1m bars prior

features.name: price_vs_sma20_atr
features.definition: (flip.c - sma20_1m.value) / atr_14, where sma20_1m INCLUDES flip bar (updated before _check_confirmation)

features.name: price_vs_sma50_atr
features.definition: (flip.c - sma50_1m.value) / atr_14

features.name: sma20_slope_atr
features.definition: (sma20_1m.value - sma20 5 bars ago) / atr_14. Uses _prev_sma20 deque maxlen=6 to look back.

features.name: sma20_vs_sma50_atr
features.definition: (sma20.value - sma50.value) / atr_14

features.name: sma50_slope_atr
features.definition: (sma50.value - sma50 10 bars ago) / atr_14. Uses _prev_sma50 deque maxlen=11.

features.name: ema3_slope_atr
features.definition: (ema3.value - ema3 5 bars ago) / atr_14. Uses _prev_ema3 deque maxlen=6.

features.name: ema_spread_atr
features.definition: (emaH3 - emaL3) / atr_14 from regime_1m state

features.name: ema3_ema9_spread_atr
features.definition: (ema3.value - ema9.value) / atr_14

features.name: vol_1m_20avg
features.definition: Mean of last 20 1m bar volumes (rolling)

features.name: vol_ratio_up_down_10bar
features.definition: Sum up_vol / sum down_vol over last 10 1m bars

features.name: vol_ratio_up_down_20bar
features.definition: Same over last 20 1m bars

features.name: vol_acceleration_5bar
features.definition: (last 5 bars avg vol - prior 5 bars avg vol) / prior 5 bars avg vol

features.name: high_vol_bar_count_10
features.definition: Count of bars in last 10 with vol > 1.5 × vol_1m_20avg

features.name: cumulative_volume_bias_10
features.definition: Sum of (up_vol - down_vol) over last 10 1m bars / sum total_vol

features.name: hour_of_day
features.definition: Hour of CT timezone at signal_time

features.name: minute_of_hour
features.definition: Minute of hour at signal_time CT

features.name: minutes_since_rth_open
features.definition: ct_min - 510 (510 = 8:30 CT). Negative pre-RTH.

features.name: distance_from_session_high_atr
features.definition: (session_high - flip.c) / atr_14. Session resets at 17:00 CT.

features.name: distance_from_session_low_atr
features.definition: (flip.c - session_low) / atr_14

features.name: regime_30s_aligned_t0
features.definition: 1 if regime_30s.regime == signal_direction at signal_time, else 0. Read in _check_confirmation (collector). Reflects 30s state INCLUDING any 30s bars closed before signal_time.

features.name: regime_5m_aligned_t0
features.definition: 1 if regime_5m.regime == signal_direction at signal_time, else 0. Read in _check_confirmation AFTER bar+1's _update_5m may have updated regime_5m.
features.notes: Always 0 in current production (we exclude aligned-at-signal trades)

features.name: signal_direction
features.definition: +1 (long) or -1 (short)

features.name: atr_14_at_T
features.definition: atr_14.value at decision_time. For T=0, same as atr_at_signal.

features.name: regime_30s_T
features.definition: regime_30s.regime at decision_time (-1, 0, 1)

features.name: regime_30s_aligned_T
features.definition: 1 if regime_30s_T == signal_direction else 0

features.name: regime_30s_duration_bars_T
features.definition: regime_30s.bars_in_regime at decision_time

features.name: ema3_slope_30s_atr_T
features.definition: Always 0.0 in current collector (placeholder, not tracking 30s ema3 slope history)
features.notes: Hardcoded 0.0 in collector — kept for parity

features.name: ema_spread_30s_atr_T
features.definition: (emaH_3.value - emaL_3.value) / atr_at_signal from regime_30s state at decision_time

features.name: price_vs_sma20_30s_atr_T
features.definition: (current 1s close - sma20_30s.value) / atr_at_signal

features.name: bar_range_30s_current_atr_T
features.definition: Range of CURRENT in-progress 30s bar (max(h)-min(l) of buffered 1s bars in _1s_for_30s) / atr_at_signal. 0 if buffer empty.

features.name: regime_5m_T
features.definition: regime_5m.regime at decision_time (-1, 0, 1)

features.name: regime_5m_duration_bars_T
features.definition: regime_5m.bars_in_regime at decision_time

features.name: ema3_slope_5m_atr_T
features.definition: Always 0.0 (placeholder)

features.name: ema_spread_5m_atr_T
features.definition: (emaH_3.value - emaL_3.value) / atr_at_signal from regime_5m state

features.name: price_vs_sma20_5m_atr_T
features.definition: (current 1s close - sma20_5m.value) / atr_at_signal

features.name: regime_5m_changed_during_delay_by_T
features.definition: 1 if regime_5m_T != regime_5m_at_signal else 0. For T=0, this is 0 by construction.

features.name: regime_1m_T
features.definition: regime_1m.regime at decision_time. For T=0, equals signal_direction (regime is sticky after the flip).

features.name: micro_same_dir_count_12s_T
features.definition: Count of 1s bars in last 12 with close moving in trade direction (close > prev_close for long)

features.name: micro_opp_dir_count_12s_T
features.definition: Count of opposite-direction 1s bars in last 12

features.name: micro_aligned_T
features.definition: 1 if same_dir_count / total_count >= 0.583 (7/12) else 0

features.name: micro_opposing_T
features.definition: 1 if opp_dir_count / total_count >= 0.583 else 0

features.name: micro_net_return_atr_T
features.definition: (last_1s_close - first_1s_close in last 12) * direction / atr_at_signal

features.name: micro_range_compression_T
features.definition: Mean range of last 6 1s bars / mean range of prior 6. 1.0 if either is 0.

features.name: micro_body_pct_avg_T
features.definition: Mean of |c-o|/(h-l) across last 12 1s bars (skipping bars with range==0). 0.5 if no valid bars.

features.name: continuation_count_since_signal_T
features.definition: Count of bars after signal where price moved in trade direction. Always 0 at T=0.
features.notes: Always 0 at T=0; informative at T>0

features.name: consecutive_continuation_bars_T
features.definition: Consecutive continuation bars. Always 0 at T=0.

features.name: bars_since_last_continuation_T
features.definition: Bars since last continuation. Always 0 at T=0.

features.name: checkpoint_bars_since_signal_1m_T
features.definition: Number of 1m bars between signal_time and decision_time. Always 0 at T=0.

features.name: is_rth_T
features.definition: 1 if 510 <= ct_min < 900 at decision_time else 0

features.name: hour_of_day_T
features.definition: Hour of CT at decision_time

features.name: minute_of_hour_T
features.definition: Minute of hour CT at decision_time

features.name: minutes_since_rth_open_T
features.definition: ct_min - 510 at decision_time

features.name: distance_from_session_high_atr_T
features.definition: (session_high - current_1s_close) / atr_at_signal at decision_time

features.name: distance_from_session_low_atr_T
features.definition: (current_1s_close - session_low) / atr_at_signal

features.name: vol_total_30s_recent_T
features.definition: Sum of volumes of buffered 1s bars in current 30s (_1s_for_30s). 0 if buffer empty.

features.name: vol_vs_20avg_30s_T
features.definition: vol_total_30s_recent_T / mean of last 20 closed 30s bar volumes. 1.0 if <20 bars buffered or avg==0.
